name: Atlassian Bitbucket Integration
description: Integration pack for Atlassian Bitbucket Cloud and Data Center, providing connectivity to Git repositories, Pull Request code reviews, branch permissions, and Bitbucket Pipelines.

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Integrates Bitbucket Pull Request approvals, inline code comments, and merge check policies.

capabilities.name: DevOps & CI/CD Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates Bitbucket Pipelines YAML build steps, deployment environments, and build status checks.

checklists.name: Bitbucket Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Bitbucket App Password / OAuth credentials, webhooks, and pipeline status checks.

items.statement: Bitbucket App Password or OAuth Consumer token grants repository and pullrequest permissions.
Bitbucket Webhooks notify target endpoints on repo:push and pullrequest:created events.
Pull Request merge checks require minimum approved reviewers and successful pipeline builds.

reviewGates.name: Bitbucket Integration Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Lead Developer confirms that Bitbucket API connections and Pull Request merge checks satisfy code review rules.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Bitbucket integration verify Pull Request approval rules and webhook event delivery?
